description: This file defines the 'SubscriptionPlan' controller class within the admin catalog namespace of an OpenCart project. It handles CRUD operations, listing, and form management for subscription plans in the admin panel.

classes.name: SubscriptionPlan
classes.description: Controller class for managing subscription plans in the admin catalog area. Provides methods for listing, form display, and saving subscription plan data.

classes.name: SubscriptionPlan
classes.description: Controller class for managing subscription plans in the admin catalog area. Provides methods for listing, form display, saving, copying, and deleting subscription plans.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Loads the list view of subscription plans, sets up breadcrumbs, sorting, ordering, pagination, and fetches data via model methods.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Handles the viewing of the subscription plan list, sets default sorting parameters, and renders the list view.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Fetches and prepares the list of subscription plans based on sorting, ordering, and pagination parameters, then renders the list view.

methods.name: form
methods.description: Displays the form for creating or editing a subscription plan, pre-filling data if in edit mode.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Processes form data to create or update a subscription plan (not fully shown in the chunk).

methods.name: copy
methods.description: Copies selected subscription plans by invoking model methods, and returns a JSON response indicating success or errors.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes selected subscription plans via model methods, with permission checks, and returns a JSON response.
